headline: Sanctions against banks and cryptocurrency hit Kyrgyzstan's reputation — US ambassador
summary: The US ambassador to Kyrgyzstan said sanctions risks in the country's banking and cryptocurrency sectors pose a serious threat to its international reputation. The input does not specify particular sanctions or actions.
why: Sanctions exposure can cut banks off from correspondent dealings and international payments, and it raises compliance costs for crypto firms operating in affected jurisdictions.
original_headline: Санкции против банков и криптовалюты бьют по репутации Кыргызстана — посол США
